script.problem: The one line is more than one sentence.

terra.problem: Naioth is labeled a city, but the verses and sources do not establish that it was a city. They describe it as a place in or near Ramah.
“Saul’s Messengers Prophesy” says the Spirit of God came upon each group. The passage explicitly says this only of the first group; it says the other groups also prophesied.
“David Flees to Jonathan” includes David’s conversation with Jonathan after he fled Naioth. The passage does not say that conversation took place at Naioth.
